Type: deco
Name: AmazonBasics Recycled Wood Deck Hanging Planter - 2-Pack, 18.9" x 7.87" x 7.5"
Colors: Black
Materials: Wood
2-pack of hanging box planters made from recycled pine panels Ideal for outdoor plants, shrubbery, flowers, vegetables, and more Durable powder-coated steel hooks hang over a railing or sill for stability; use with or without hooks Includes hard plastic soil liner that can be removed for easy filling Recycled pine wood includes natural knocks, dents, and nail holes for classic rustic appeal Predrilled drain holes allow for controlled drainage and prevent water logging of the plant roots Dimensions: 18.9 x 7.87 x 7.5 inches
